meaning:
1) cry, outcry
1a) outcry
1b) cry of distress
1c) outcry, clamour

elsewhere.note: Yahweh said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,
I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
Now when Mordecai found out all that was done, Mordecai tore his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the middle of the city, and wailed…
“Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.
Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.
My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim…
Let a cry be heard from their houses when you bring a troop suddenly on them; for they have dug a pit to take me and hidden snares for my feet.
